attempts.text:
**The window starts in a long persistent stretch.** Columns 0 to 32 are spine, carried by 97 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, and in a region of plasticity in 0 to 25% of calls. The model names 29 to 100% of genes there, 96% on average, and hesitates most at column 28 (`pstS`), 0.79 bits.

**Then the graph opens at the `bgl` fork.** Columns 33 to 40 are fork and variable columns, in a region of plasticity in 42 to 73% of calls, and the model names 73 to 92% of genes, 84% on average. A second branch of 3 families runs through columns 37 to 39, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, carried by 10 to 19% of chromosomes. The model names 73% at column 34 and hesitates most at column 33 (`bglG`), 0.78 bits.

**A second spine follows.** Columns 41 to 59 are spine, carried by 95 to 99% of chromosomes, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 2 to 16% of calls. The model names 93 to 98% of genes, 96% on average, and is least sure at column 49 (`tnaC`), named 93%, 0.39 bits.

**The window ends among variable and fork columns.** Columns 63 to 66 are variable, in a region of plasticity in 66 to 74% of calls, the `dgo` operon, [[galactonate catabolism]], carried by 86 to 90% of chromosomes; the model names 92 to 95% of genes there. Columns 73 to 79 are fork and variable columns, in a region of plasticity in 25 to 66% of calls, where the model names 82 to 91% of genes and hesitates most at column 75, 0.52 bits. Across the window, inside a region of plasticity the model hesitates more than outside, 0.55 against 0.15 bits, and names fewer genes, 86% against 94%.

label: hdfR
facts:
WINDOW: the hdfR window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor hdfR, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 4,358 to 4,437 from dnaA. Read in 537 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying hdfR once); 42,433 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 92% of genes, 0.23 bits on average (perplexity 1.4 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 32,559 calls, named 95%, 0.12 bits; shell 9,747 calls, named 85%, 0.54 bits; cloud 127 calls, named 6%, 4.01 bits. Outside an RGP 33,390 calls, named 94%, 0.15 bits; inside an RGP 9,043 calls, named 86%, 0.55 bits. Columns: 60 spine, 8 fork, 12 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.55 against 0.15 bits) and names fewer genes (86% against 94%); 9,043 of the 42,433 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 28 (pstS) 0.79 bits, RGP 23%; column 33 (bglG) 0.78 bits, RGP 64%; column 37 (yieL) 0.74 bits, RGP 73%. The 15 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 87%, 0.44 bits on average; the other 65 columns: named 94%, 0.18 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 63-66 (variable), RGP 66-74%; the least: columns 0-32 (spine), RGP 0-25%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-32 (33 columns) spine: share 97-100%, all P, RGP 0-25%. Genes: hdfR, yieP "FadR/GntR family transcriptional re…", mdtD, rbsR, rbsK, rbsB, rbsC "ribose ABC transporter permease", rbsA, rbsD, kup, ravA, viaA, asnA "aspartate--ammonia ligase", asnC, mioC, mnmG, rsmG, atpI, atpB, atpE, atpF, atpH "F0F1 ATP synthase subunit delta", atpA, atpG, atpD, atpC, glmU "bifunctional UDP-N-acetylglucosamin…", glmS, pstS, pstC, pstA "phosphate ABC transporter permease…", pstB, phoU. named 29-100% (mean 96%), fewest named at column 30 (pstA), named 29%; most hesitant at column 28 (pstS), 0.79 bits.
2. columns 33-40 (8 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 42-73%. named 73-92% (mean 84%), fewest named at column 34, named 73%; most hesitant at column 33, 0.78 bits.
   a second branch of 3 families through columns 37-39, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 10-19%, all S; the branch's families: "hypothetical protein", "pentapeptide repeat-containing protein", espY4
   33 fork: bglG S 67%; also "IS1-like element transposase" S 19%
   34 variable: bglF S 67%
   35 variable: bglB S 67%
   36 variable: bglH S 62% "carbohydrate porin"
   37 fork: yieL S 65% "alpha/beta hydrolase-fold protein"
   38 fork: yieK S 71% "glucosamine-6-phosphate deaminase"
   39 fork: cbrC S 47% "PF03691 family colicin E2 tolerance…"
   40 variable: cbrB S 73%
3. columns 41-59 (19 columns) spine: share 95-99%, all P, RGP 2-16%. Genes: yieH "6-phosphogluconate phosphatase", adeP, yieF "class I chromate reductase YieF", yieE "4'-phosphopantetheinyl transferase…", yidZ "HTH-type transcriptional regulator…", mdtL, tnaB, tnaA, tnaC "tryptophanase leader peptide", mnmE, yidC "membrane protein insertase YidC", yidD "membrane protein insertion efficien…", rnpA, rpmH, "protein YsdD", dnaA "helix-turn-helix domain-containing…", dnaN, recF, gyrB. named 93-98% (mean 96%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 49 (tnaC), named 93%, 0.39 bits.
4. column 60 variable: RGP 25%. named 89%; 0.27 bits.
   60: yidB P 89% "YidB family protein"
5. columns 61-62 (2 columns) spine: share 90-98%, 1 P, 1 S, RGP 49-72%. Genes: yidA "Cof-type HAD-IIB family hydrolase", dgoR. named 87-93% (mean 90%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 61 (yidA), named 87%, 0.23 bits.
6. columns 63-66 (4 columns) variable: RGP 66-74%. named 92-95% (mean 94%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 66, named 92%, 0.24 bits.
   63: dgoK S 88%
   64: dgoA S 90% "2-dehydro-3-deoxy-6-phosphogalacton…"
   65: dgoD S 88%
   66: dgoT S 86%
7. columns 67-72 (6 columns) spine: share 94-96%, all P, RGP 20-39%. Genes: cbrA, yidR, yidQ "YceK/YidQ family lipoprotein", ibpA "small heat shock chaperone IbpA", ibpB, yidE. named 71-92% (mean 83%), fewest named at column 71 (ibpB), named 71%; most hesitant at column 67 (cbrA), 0.27 bits.
8. columns 73-79 (7 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 25-66%. named 82-91% (mean 86%), fewest named at column 76, named 82%; most hesitant at column 75, 0.52 bits.
   73 variable: trkH P 1%
   74 fork: glvC S 78%; also yidP S 74%, yidK S 66%
   75 variable: glvA S 44% "maltose-6'-phosphate glucosidase"
   76 variable: yidL S 72% "helix-turn-helix transcriptional re…"
   77 fork: yidH P 69% "YidH family protein"; also yidJ S 66%, insQ S 13%
   78 fork: yidG P 55% "DUF202 domain-containing protein"; also yidI S 52%
   79 fork: yidF P 41% "radical SAM protein"; also emrD P 27%, ysdE P 14%
